name: Hurricane Harvey

steps.label: −48h · Forecast
steps.narrative: Forecast: Harvey expected to stall over Houston. NWS warns of catastrophic, life-threatening rainfall.

steps.label: −24h · Forecast
steps.narrative: Forecast: 30–40 in. of rain possible. Bayous and reservoirs projected to overtop.

steps.label: −12h · Forecast
steps.narrative: Final window for pre-storm actions. Rain bands arriving.

steps.label: 0h · Impact
steps.narrative: Impact: Buffalo, Brays and White Oak bayous out of their banks. Substations flooding.

steps.label: +12h · Impact
steps.narrative: Peak flooding. Reservoir releases flood the Energy Corridor.

steps.label: +48h · Recovery
steps.narrative: Water receding slowly. Power restoration begins in dry areas.

steps.label: +7d · Recovery
steps.narrative: Recovery: most water gone. Demand surge for contractors and materials.

sources: NOAA National Hurricane Center: Tropical Cyclone Report, Hurricane Harvey (AL092017)
NWS Houston/Galveston: Hurricane Harvey event summary
disclaimer: Hazard footprints are approximate and illustrative, not official flood maps. Buildings and dollar figures are synthetic.
